title: Stability of p-area minimizing surfaces in the Heisenberg group
summary: We study the stability of minimizers of weighted $p$-area functionals associated with prescribed $p$-mean curvature surfaces in the Heisenberg group. While existence and uniqueness results are well established, quantitative stability with respect to perturbations of the mean curvature $H$ remains largely unexplored in the nonzero-$H$ regime. Using a Rockafellar--Fenchel duality framework, we identify a unique underlying vector field associated with each minimizer and prove its stability under perturbations of $H$.
